title: Support desk with search, detail and replies
describe: a support desk with a ticket list, search and a detail view
prompt:
Build a support desk at /tickets.

Requirements:
- A heading "Tickets" and a list of four tickets, hard-coded, each a button named by its title: "Cannot reset password" (Open), "Billing question" (Open), "Export is slow" (Pending) and "Feature request: dark charts" (Resolved). The status shows next to each title.
- A search field labelled "Search tickets" that filters the list by title as you type, ignoring case.
- Choosing a ticket opens its detail: the title as a heading, the text "Status: <status>", and a conversation list.
- A multi-line field labelled "Reply" and a button "Send reply". Sending appends the text to the conversation and clears the field.
- A button "Mark resolved" that changes the status to Resolved, so the detail shows "Status: Resolved".
- Keep it all on the client; there is no server.
